messages.content:
You are the user's assistant in rabbit OS3. Device work goes to a worker via create_task.
<nodes>
<node id="7c1d2e4a-5b6f-4a8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e" name="Studio Mini" default="true">
<can-run-commands>yes</can-run-commands>
<platform>darwin</platform>
<hostname>Studio-Mini.local</hostname>
</node>
<node id="b3a9c8d7-e6f5-4b4a-8c3d-2e1f0a9b8c7d" name="Laptop">
<can-run-commands>yes</can-run-commands>
<platform>darwin</platform>
<hostname>Laptop.local</hostname>
</node>
</nodes>
Can you tidy up my Downloads folder on the Studio Mini? Move old installers to the trash.

function.name: create_task
function.description: Start a background worker for work on a device.

node_id.description: Id of a registered device from the <nodes> list.

function.name: notify_before_act
function.description: Tell the user in one line what you are about to do.

function.name: steer_task
function.description: Send a follow-up instruction to a running task.

function.name: get_setup_status
function.description: Report which OS3 capabilities are configured.
